outputs.headline: यह दावा गलत है: प्रधानमंत्री मोदी मुफ्त मोबाइल रिचार्ज नहीं दे रहे हैं

outputs.what_post_claims: पोस्ट का दावा है कि प्रधानमंत्री मोदी सभी भारतीयों को 3 महीने का मुफ्त मोबाइल रिचार्ज दे रहे हैं।
outputs.what_is_true: भारत सरकार ऐसी कोई मुफ्त मोबाइल रिचार्ज योजना नहीं चला रही है। ऐसे संदेश धोखाधड़ी हैं जिनका उद्देश्य आपकी व्यक्तिगत जानकारी चुराना है।
evidence_against: बूम ने पाया कि पीएम मोदी के 3 महीने के मुफ्त मोबाइल रिचार्ज की घोषणा करने वाला वीडियो एडिट किया गया है।

outputs.headline: Scam: PM Modi is not giving 3 months free mobile recharge
outputs.summary: Messages claiming Prime Minister Modi is offering free mobile recharge are scams designed to steal your personal information.
outputs.what_post_claims: The post claims that Prime Minister Modi is giving all Indians 3 months of free mobile recharge.
outputs.what_is_true: The Indian government is not offering a 3-month free mobile recharge. Messages claiming this are scams designed to steal personal information.
evidence_against: BOOM found that videos claiming PM Modi announced free recharge are edited and false.
Vishvas News confirmed that the viral claim of a free mobile recharge scheme in PM Modi's name is fake.
FACTLY and the Press Information Bureau (PIB) have repeatedly debunked these claims as scams.
outputs.sources_spoken: BOOM, Vishvas News, FACTLY, and the Press Information Bureau
outputs.audio_script: The post claims that Prime Minister Modi is giving all Indians three months of free mobile recharge. This is a scam. The Indian government is not offering any such scheme. Messages like these are designed to steal your personal information. We are very sure about this. This information comes from fact-checking organisations like BOOM, Vishvas News, FACTLY, and the Press Information Bureau, who have all debunked these claims.

Claim: PM Modi is offering 3 months free mobile recharge.
Truth: This is a scam to steal your data.
